Strategy: Scaled awkward-plus-second-ratio avoidance. Exact fits score highest; residuals in the awkward band between a third and the full item, and residuals near twice the item, lose half the item, while other residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit falls in either penalized zone while a looser bin avoids both. It may help by avoiding two awkward leftover sizes, but may fail if it pushes items into roomy bins too often.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - item / 2 if (r - item > item / 3 and r - item <= item) or round((r - item) / item) == 2 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Scaled awkward-plus-second-ratio avoidance: penalize (item/3, item] and round(rem/item)==2 by item/2.
